last.verdict: Investors sold on weak trading, thin core profit, and rising costs despite a headline profit.

reasons.label: Trading keeps shrinking
reasons.text: Transaction revenue was $590M, down 44% from a year ago as crypto volatility sank.

reasons.label: Profit flattered by gains
reasons.text: $719M net income came mostly from $715M crypto gains; adjusted profit was just $78M versus $421M.

reasons.label: Higher costs ahead
reasons.text: Q4 spending is guided to $1.0B-$1.16B versus $975M; Barclays cut its target, citing a lower revenue run rate.

story: Coinbase has now missed revenue estimates for several quarters as crypto trading dries up. Q3 revenue was $1.22B, down 35% from a year ago. The stock fell 10.6% after July's report too, and this drop came amid a wider crypto sell-off.

history.verdict: Third straight revenue miss and weak July trading pushed investors to sell hard.

reasons.label: Revenue missed again
reasons.text: Revenue was $1.22B versus about $1.32B expected, down 19% from a year ago.

reasons.label: Weak July trading
reasons.text: Trading revenue was only about $130M through July 26, after $599M in the second quarter.

reasons.label: Services revenue fell short
reasons.text: Subscription and services revenue missed Coinbase's own guide. Next quarter is guided at $500M-$580M.
